Description - GET /session

Not sent by the client. Live probe of http://box.chomikuj.pl/session, the /session path on the main host, to check whether the session server exists there: it answers 302 to /Error404.aspx.

Path notes

URL http://<session host>/session used only by SessionBegin. The GET operation documents a live probe of the same path on the main host.

Client vs live - discrepancies

Security notes - findings that concern GET /session

  • S-12 Low session.box.chomikuj.pl (SessionBegin) no longer resolves in DNS; whoever registered it would receive the user name and password hash from old clients with session-enabled=true (off by default).

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
